billing_accounts_pending_checkout_comple.name: billing_accounts_pending_checkout_complete_check
billing_accounts_pending_checkout_comple.value:
(
      "billing_accounts"."pending_checkout_session_id" IS NULL AND
      "billing_accounts"."pending_checkout_plan_key" IS NULL AND
      "billing_accounts"."pending_checkout_expires_at" IS NULL AND
      "billing_accounts"."pending_checkout_idempotency_key" IS NULL
    ) OR (
      "billing_accounts"."pending_checkout_session_id" IS NOT NULL AND
      "billing_accounts"."pending_checkout_plan_key" IS NOT NULL AND "billing_accounts"."pending_checkout_plan_key" IN ('pro', 'enterprise') AND
      "billing_accounts"."pending_checkout_expires_at" IS NOT NULL AND
      "billing_accounts"."pending_checkout_idempotency_key" IS NOT NULL
    )

billing_subscriptions_period_order_check.name: billing_subscriptions_period_order_check
billing_subscriptions_period_order_check.value: "billing_subscriptions"."current_period_start" IS NULL OR "billing_subscriptions"."current_period_end" IS NULL OR "billing_subscriptions"."current_period_end" >= "billing_subscriptions"."current_period_start"

billing_subscriptions_trial_order_check.name: billing_subscriptions_trial_order_check
billing_subscriptions_trial_order_check.value: "billing_subscriptions"."trial_start" IS NULL OR "billing_subscriptions"."trial_end" IS NULL OR "billing_subscriptions"."trial_end" >= "billing_subscriptions"."trial_start"

billing_subscriptions_grace_order_check.name: billing_subscriptions_grace_order_check
billing_subscriptions_grace_order_check.value: "billing_subscriptions"."grace_started_at" IS NULL OR "billing_subscriptions"."grace_until" IS NULL OR "billing_subscriptions"."grace_until" >= "billing_subscriptions"."grace_started_at"

billing_subscriptions_pending_switch_com.name: billing_subscriptions_pending_switch_complete_check

grandfathering_cohort_members_applied_ch.name: grandfathering_cohort_members_applied_check
grandfathering_cohort_members_applied_ch.value: "grandfathering_cohort_members"."member_state" IN ('candidate', 'excluded') OR ("grandfathering_cohort_members"."applied_at" IS NOT NULL AND "grandfathering_cohort_members"."grandfathered_at" IS NOT NULL)

stripe_webhook_events_lease_check.name: stripe_webhook_events_lease_check
stripe_webhook_events_lease_check.value: "stripe_webhook_events"."processing_state" <> 'processing' OR ("stripe_webhook_events"."lease_token" IS NOT NULL AND "stripe_webhook_events"."lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL)
